thin: Financial assistance lists were mostly utility-bill and rent programmes; no list names a general emergency-cash source in Mesa beyond MesaCAN, the Salvation Army and (by mention) St. Vincent de Paul and Paz de Cristo. 211 results were padded with veteran-only, tribal and other-city programmes, the aggregator carries ended pandemic ERA programmes, and church and congregation help is missing from every list. The Arizona Department of Housing's Maricopa page and findhelp refused to load.
